description: Fix 3 runtime errors: (1) LTXDirector.execute() missing 9 required positional arguments by using INPUT_TYPES introspection and passing widget values, (2) LTXDirectorGuide.execute() unexpected 'retake_image' kwarg by using INPUT_TYPES introspection to only pass accepted params, (3) CUDA OOM during Pass 1 by deferring upscaler loading to after pass 1 completes.
steps: STEP 1 - Fix LTXDirector: Add INPUT_TYPES() introspection to discover accepted parameters. Build widget_defaults dict with all 9 required widget values (start_second, end_second, duration_seconds, start_frame, end_frame, duration_frames, timeline_data, local_prompts, segment_lengths) plus additional widget params. Pass only params the node declares via introspection, with fallback to the 9 known required params if introspection fails.

STEP 2 - Fix LTXDirectorGuide: Add INPUT_TYPES() introspection. Build widget_candidates dict with all 11 widget values. Only pass params the node declares. If introspection fails, pass all EXCEPT retake_image (which is known to cause the error).

STEP 3 - Fix CUDA OOM: Defer upscaler loading from step 3 (before sampling) to step 12 (after pass 1). This frees VRAM during the critical pass 1 sampling phase when LoRAs are applied to the DiT model.
acceptance_criteria: Python file passes py_compile and ast.parse without errors
LTXDirector call includes INPUT_TYPES introspection and all 9 widget params
LTXDirectorGuide call uses INPUT_TYPES introspection and excludes retake_image when not accepted
Upscaler model is loaded after pass 1 sampling (at step 12), not at step 3
No references to upscaler variable between step 3 initialization and step 12 usage
findings: All 3 runtime errors fixed: (1) LTXDirector now receives widget values computed from chunk parameters (duration, frames, fps, dimensions) via INPUT_TYPES introspection with fallback. timeline_data is built as a minimal valid JSON structure. (2) LTXDirectorGuide now only passes widget params that the node's INPUT_TYPES declares, preventing the retake_image rejection. (3) Upscaler loading deferred from step 3 to step 12, freeing ~500MB+ VRAM during the critical pass 1 sampling when LoRA patching occurs on the 14.15 GB DiT model.
